definitions.explanation: Aquatic vertebrate animals that breathe through gills and typically have fins and scales. A biological classification group.

examples.english: Salmon and sea bream are fish.

examples.japanese: {魚類|ぎょるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鰓|えら}→鰓：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚類|ぎょるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many species of fish inhabit the ocean.

notes:
{魚類|ぎょるい} is the scientific classification term for fish.

⟦{魚|ぎょ}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ means "fish" and ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ means "class/category."

Note: In everyday speech, ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ is used. {魚類|ぎょるい} is more formal/scientific.

Types of fish:
- ⟦{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}→淡水魚：28709_tansuigyo⟧ (freshwater fish)
- ⟦{海水魚|かいすいぎょ}→海水魚：noentry⟧ (saltwater fish)
- ⟦{深海魚|しんかいぎょ}→深海魚：noentry⟧ (deep-sea fish)

Related classification terms:
- ⟦{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}→哺乳類：04920_honyuurui⟧ (mammals)
- ⟦{爬虫類|はちゅうるい}→爬虫類：04921_hachuurui⟧ (reptiles)
- ⟦{鳥類|ちょうるい}→鳥類：04927_chourui⟧ (birds)
